_comment: Hand-written default results, merged over the generated ones by tools/build-server-data.py. Keys are 'Class.method' as sent by the game. Add entries here when the real app needs a different shape than the model-based default (see Unity exceptions in logcat).
_news: Promotion.getNewsData: the lobby news banner (bannerLocate 1 = LOBBY; image drawn by tools/news_banner.py, the server points the URL to itself). The client shows only entries with targetLanguage 0 in a Korean build and only entries with another language otherwise, so the banner is listed for both. A null uri or start/end time throws.
